title: The oath-stone's might-check option 'break the stone by main strength' reads like a forceful-entry attempt, but it is actually the hollow's destructive 'burn' resolution — permanent, costs Watch reputation (-2), and triggers 'Vell disapproves' — with none of the explicit 'burn' framing used elsewhere (e.g. the Ironbound Mission's plain 'burn it' choice). I picked it after two failed peaceful attempts, not realizing it would end the encounter destructively rather than just being a third skill-check attempt.
where: The Oath-Ground — Circle / 'break the stone by main strength'
